children: Lianteng Limited disclosed an 8.9% stake in TROOPS, Inc. through a Schedule 13D filing. The filing, dated September 24, 2026, follows Lianteng’s receipt of 10,912,168 ordinary shares on December 11, 2024. The stake came from converting a $13.4 million note tied to TROOPS, Inc.’s purchase of Riches Holdings Limited.

Lianteng Limited says it acquired the shares in connection with TROOPS, Inc.’s purchase of Riches Holdings and the conversion of a $13.4 million note. The firm adds that it "does not have any present plans or proposals" for major corporate actions but "may seek to influence management of the Issuer or the Board of Directors with respect to the business and affairs of the Issuer."

Lianteng leaves the door open to future changes in position, including potential discussions with advisors and TROOPS, Inc. While it offers no specific timetable or targets, the disclosure signals that the investor could take a more active role if circumstances warrant.

Lianteng Limited is a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability. The firm negotiated the sale of Riches Holdings Limited to TROOPS, Inc. and received a convertible note that it later turned into equity. Lianteng typically engages in strategic corporate transactions and may hold equity positions that arise from deal structures.
